name: Nova Prince
description: The Nova Prince was a bulk freighter operated by a group of exiles from the Red Nebula during the era of the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, the leader of these exiles, Klysk, kept a number of mercenaries, smugglers and spacers prisoner aboard the Nova Prince—these beings were kidnapped on fringe worlds like Terminus, in order to serve as thieves for an attempted heist of the Red Nebula's Great Life Jewels.

data.name: Nova Prince
data.destroyed: 0 ABY, Sun of the Planet of the Red Nebula
